item.title: A Gentle Sleep Story: The Bremen Town Musicians | German Folk Tale
item.description:
Drift off with the old tale of a donkey, a dog, a cat, and a rooster who leave their old lives behind and set out together for the town of Bremen. Along a quiet forest road and through one moonlit night in a cottage, their small, steady kindness toward one another unfolds slowly, with gentle pauses and soft narration meant to ease your mind toward sleep rather than keep it alert.
Dusk Chapters retells classic and folk stories at an unhurried pace, with a calm voice and long, restful pauses, made for listening in the dark as you fall asleep. New chapters arrive regularly for anyone who wants a familiar story instead of a screen at bedtime.
